title: Simulate Single-Stream and Server Load
summary: Distinguish closed-loop query issuance from externally arriving requests and include queue waiting in latency.

runtime.image_status: pending OCI build; baseline worker exists
runtime.budget_status: actual shared worker limits; verified before publication

physical_contract: All times are integer nanoseconds on one synthetic monotonic clock. One nonpreemptive server handles requests in input order. No physical robot, network, batching, GPU synchronization or wall-clock measurement is involved.

hidden_case_families: idle gaps and exact large integer clock

provenance.authoring_notes: The historical MLPerf2019 paper motivates scenario-dependent query issuance. The supplied-arrival, single-server FCFS recurrence is an original teaching simulator, not the official LoadGen or compliance protocol.
